# A test reads a prop through an instance when what the call site wrote
# holds a function literal: the literal's own parameters are bound wherever
# the expression is read, the test included, so they are no name a test
# lacks. Only a slot's parameter, a local or a loop variable of the body is.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component shelf ui.node {
    var names = ["ash", "elm"]
    ui.text #joined(value=names.map(func(n string) => string.upper(n)).join(", "))
}

component wrapped ui.node {
    shelf #inner()
}

func testALambdaInAPropIsRead(t test.Test, c wrapped) {
    t.assert(c.inner.joined.value == "ASH, ELM")
}
